tools.name: cms_list_theme_revisions
tools.description: List retained theme revisions for the current site; excludes pruned snapshots.

tools.name: cms_cleanup_theme_revisions
tools.description: Preview old theme snapshots (default dry_run=true, theme.read); apply with dry_run=false, explicit revision_ids and expected_generation (theme.write). Keeps active, previous good, latest five and snapshots used within one day. At most 100 per batch. Pruning is irreversible; retry pending file removal with the same IDs.

tools.name: cms_get_server_info
tools.description: Server identity and subsystem contract versions.

tools.name: cms_get_capabilities
tools.description: Capability report for the current actor: installed subsystems, allowed operation classes, contract versions.

tools.name: cms_get_current_actor
tools.description: Non-secret projection of the authenticated actor (scopes, site/environment binding) — agents detect missing permissions before large workflows (spec §53).

tools.name: cms_get_agent_bootstrap
tools.description: M16 agent bootstrap: target site, environment classification, actor + effective scopes, contract versions, capabilities, installed skills with compatibility, preview/domain readiness. Secret-free; call this before any workflow.

tools.name: cms_resolve_external_identity
tools.description: Resolve an external source item (source_namespace + external_id) to its bound entry, with the human-edit reconciliation verdict (IN_SYNC / HUMAN_EDIT_CONFLICT / BASELINE_UNSET) — never overwrite on conflict (M16).

tools.name: cms_bind_external_identity
tools.description: Bind an external source item to an entry and/or refresh the agent sync baseline (last applied generation, source hash, run id). Idempotent for the same entry; conflicts on a different bound entry (M16).

tools.name: cms_get_site_info
tools.description: Baseline site identity, route policy and domain bindings.

tools.name: cms_list_content_types
tools.description: Registered content types (deterministic order).

tools.name: cms_get_content_type
tools.description: Full content type schema — round-trippable payload contract.

tools.name: cms_list_block_types
tools.description: Registered block types.

tools.name: cms_get_block_schema
tools.description: Block schema: props, children policy, references.

tools.name: cms_get_collection_capabilities
tools.description: Collection DSL capabilities (typed allowlist operations).

tools.name: cms_get_theme_contract
tools.description: Theme contract snapshot: manifest, templates, placements (unavailable when no theme source is configured).

tools.name: cms_list_navigation_sets
tools.description: Navigation sets.

tools.name: cms_get_navigation_tree
tools.description: Materialized navigation tree by set id or key.

tools.name: cms_list_media_presets
tools.description: Registered media presets.

tools.name: cms_search_query
tools.description: Public site search over the derived PostgreSQL full-text index (bounded, paginated; Search spec §23). Same site/locale scoping as REST.

tools.name: cms_search_admin
tools.description: Authorized admin search across the public index, draft titles, media metadata and navigation labels (Search spec §24).

tools.name: cms_get_indexnow_settings
tools.description: IndexNow settings (site-level, DISABLED by default): enabled state, notify flags, CAS generation (IndexNow spec §29).

tools.name: cms_update_indexnow_settings
tools.description: Enable/disable IndexNow and its notify flags (CAS on expected_generation; enabling generates the verification key and queues at most ONE homepage notification — never a backfill).

tools.name: cms_get_indexnow_status
tools.description: IndexNow delivery status: state, key file URL, pending count, last HTTP result, diagnostics. Never claims indexing.

tools.name: cms_check_indexnow
tools.description: Local IndexNow checks + enqueue the single homepage verification notification (delivered asynchronously by the worker).

tools.name: cms_rotate_indexnow_key
tools.description: Rotate the IndexNow verification key (queued jobs resolve the key at send time; audit recorded).

tools.name: cms_get_analytics_settings
tools.description: Analytics & tagging settings with CAS generation: enabled providers, ids, network rules (Analytics spec §10).

tools.name: cms_update_analytics_settings
tools.description: Save analytics & tagging settings (CAS on expected_generation; strict validation, typed provider configs only — arbitrary script/HTML is impossible by contract).

tools.name: cms_list_analytics_providers
tools.description: Registered analytics tag providers: ids, titles, strict config schemas, privacy categories.

tools.name: cms_analytics_doctor
tools.description: Analytics installation diagnostics: config validity, render-plan probe, slot presence, CSP compatibility, duplication warnings.

tools.name: cms_get_search_status
tools.description: Search index health: document count, index version vs expected, last event, reindex progress (Search spec §26).

tools.name: cms_get_search_capabilities
tools.description: Machine-readable search capabilities: entity types, filters, sorts, hard limits.

tools.name: cms_validate_search_document
tools.description: Re-derive one entity's public search document and return structural issues without exposing content (Search spec §31).

tools.name: cms_reindex_search
tools.description: Start (or resume) a full shadow-epoch reindex; returns run progress fields (Search spec §19/§20).

tools.name: cms_list_forms
tools.description: List form definitions with their current schema version (Forms spec §36).

tools.name: cms_get_form_definition
tools.description: One form definition: stable identity, field set and server-validation rules of the current version (Forms spec §4–§8).

tools.name: cms_list_quizzes
tools.description: List quiz definitions with their current schema version (Forms spec §36).

tools.name: cms_get_quiz_definition
tools.description: One quiz definition: steps, questions, declarative branching/scoring rules and outcomes (Forms spec §9–§15).

tools.name: cms_get_quiz_public_schema
tools.description: Sanitized public quiz schema (steps/questions only — no scoring weights or branch targets) for rendering clients (Forms spec §36).

tools.name: cms_list_submissions
tools.description: Bounded, cursor-paginated form submission history (Forms spec §36; interactions.read).

tools.name: cms_get_submission
tools.description: One form submission with normalized payload and consent snapshot (interactions.read; PII).

tools.name: cms_list_quiz_runs
tools.description: Bounded quiz run history with server-computed score/outcome (interactions.read).

tools.name: cms_get_quiz_run
tools.description: One quiz run: lifecycle, score/outcome and all server-recorded answers (interactions.read).

tools.name: cms_list_leads
tools.description: Bounded lead list — PII, permission-gated (leads.read).

tools.name: cms_update_lead_status
tools.description: Lead lifecycle transition; emits LeadStatusChanged atomically (leads.manage).

tools.name: cms_export_interactions
tools.description: Permission-gated, audited CSV/JSON export of submissions, quiz runs or leads (Forms spec §29; interactions.export / leads.export).

tools.name: cms_search_media
tools.description: Bounded media search with typed filters (text, kind). Follow next_cursor until has_more=false for a full catalog.

tools.name: cms_get_media
tools.description: Full media asset view: versions and variants.

tools.name: cms_get_media_usage
tools.description: Inbound references and source titles. Review before media cleanup.

tools.name: cms_archive_media
tools.description: Archive an unused media asset after explicit confirmation. Usage is checked first; referenced assets are refused. Requires media.read and media.archive.

tools.name: cms_list_seo_entries
tools.description: Active Content Tree page for a full SEO audit. Skip folders; follow next_cursor to exhaustion and validate each entry with cms_validate_seo.

tools.name: cms_validate_seo
tools.description: SEO validation report for one entry: issues, severities and resolved metadata. Requires seo.validate.

tools.name: cms_change_entry_route
tools.description: Explicit canonical route change, recording the old URL as a 301 redirect. Requires navigation.edit and explicit confirmation. Conflicts are never forced.

tools.name: cms_get_seo_schema
tools.description: SEO document schema descriptor and diagnostic codes.

tools.name: cms_check_route_available
tools.description: Route availability check (typed issues; never reserves).

tools.name: cms_list_revisions
tools.description: Revision history of an entity (bounded).

tools.name: cms_get_changeset
tools.description: ChangeSet with its items.

tools.name: cms_list_changesets
tools.description: Recent ChangeSets (bounded).

tools.name: cms_list_publication_calendar
tools.description: Publication calendar window.

tools.name: cms_create_draft
tools.description: Create an entry + first working revision atomically. Payload: {fields, blocks} per the content type schema. parent_entry_id may be a folder (kind=folder rows in /discovery/content/tree are structural only: they cannot be sealed, published, routed, previewed, SEO-documented or duplicated).

tools.name: cms_update_draft
tools.description: Autosave a working revision; requires the current edit_generation (CAS).

tools.name: cms_validate_revision
tools.description: Validate a revision against publish-level rules; returns structured issues.

tools.name: cms_seal_revision
tools.description: Seal a working revision (publish-level validation runs inside the domain).

tools.name: cms_cleanup_entry_revisions
tools.description: Bulk cleanup (iterative-editing case): delete all SEALED revisions of an entry except the currently published one. The working revision is always kept; refuses entries without a published revision (409 REVISION_CLEANUP_NO_PUBLISHED). Requires content.edit.

tools.name: cms_delete_revision
tools.description: Delete a WORKING or SEALED revision (cleanup of drafts/garbage). The currently published revision is rejected (REVISION_PUBLISHED) — unpublish or publish another revision first. Audited, irreversible.

tools.name: cms_create_changeset
tools.description: Create a ChangeSet (coordinated release container).

tools.name: cms_add_changeset_item
tools.description: Add a candidate (sealed revision + optional route operation) to a ChangeSet with its CAS generation.

tools.name: cms_preflight_changeset
tools.description: Validate the whole release without applying it.

tools.name: cms_apply_changeset
tools.description: Apply the release: every public pointer/route move in ONE transaction. Requires publication.publish.

tools.name: cms_create_plan
tools.description: Create a publication plan (timezone-aware batch scheduling).

tools.name: cms_preview_plan
tools.description: Dry-run the batch schedule (nothing persisted).

tools.name: cms_schedule_plan
tools.description: Materialize timestamps and enqueue idempotent publish jobs.

tools.name: cms_publish_now
tools.description: Cancel the pending schedule and publish exactly once. Requires publication.publish.

tools.name: cms_publish_revision
tools.description: Direct single-entity publish with generation CAS. Requires publication.publish — never granted to default agent scopes.

tools.name: cms_validate_theme
tools.description: Validate the configured theme source against the theme contract.

tools.name: cms_create_preview
tools.description: Create a signed, expiring preview reference for a revision or changeset.

tools.name: cms_submit_bundle
tools.description: Publication Bundle: validate or atomically apply a coordinated content batch (mode: validate|apply). Strict all-or-nothing; supports ref:<id> intra-bundle references.

tools.name: cms_update_media_metadata
tools.description: Update descriptive media metadata (title/alt/caption).

tools.name: cms_archive_entry
tools.description: Archive an entry (idempotent; never a hard delete).

tools.name: cms_list_connectors
tools.description: Registered integration connector catalog with typed contracts.

tools.name: cms_get_connector_schema
tools.description: Connector config schema, secret requirements and supported actions.

tools.name: cms_list_integration_instances
tools.description: Configured connections (secret refs are names, never values).

tools.name: cms_create_integration_instance
tools.description: Configure a connection (integrations.configure; secret refs additionally integrations.secrets.manage).

tools.name: cms_update_integration_instance
tools.description: Update a configured connection.

tools.name: cms_test_integration_instance
tools.description: Run the safe connector-specific connection probe (audited).

tools.name: cms_list_integration_bindings
tools.description: Event-to-action bindings with bounded conditions.

tools.name: cms_create_integration_binding
tools.description: Bind a domain event type to configured actions.

tools.name: cms_update_integration_binding
tools.description: Update a binding (enable/disable, conditions, actions, policy).

tools.name: cms_list_integration_deliveries
tools.description: Outbound delivery history with reliability states.

tools.name: cms_get_integration_delivery
tools.description: One delivery with its complete attempt history.

tools.name: cms_retry_integration_delivery
tools.description: Manual retry of a failed delivery (permission-gated, audited).

tools.name: cms_list_inbound_events
tools.description: Inbound provider events (metadata only; raw payloads protected).

tools.name: cms_get_contract_versions
tools.description: Independent contract versions: cms, config, extension, REST, MCP, theme, blocks, search.

tools.name: cms_get_extension_capabilities
tools.description: Effective capability provisions (key, version, provider).

tools.name: cms_list_extensions
tools.description: Deployed extensions with lifecycle state, capabilities and compatibility.

tools.name: cms_get_extension_compatibility
tools.description: Machine-readable compatibility issues for one extension.

tools.name: cms_get_update_preflight
tools.description: Read-only update preflight against the configured target release manifest.

tools.name: cms_list_deprecations
tools.description: Deprecation records with replacement and planned removal metadata.

tools.name: cms_extension_install
tools.description: Activate an already-deployed trusted extension artifact (extensions.manage; audited).

tools.name: cms_extension_enable
tools.description: Enable an installed extension after its preflight (audited).

tools.name: cms_extension_disable
tools.description: Disable an extension; impact preflight blocks active dependents (audited).

tools.name: cms_extension_uninstall
tools.description: Remove executable extension state; destructive data policies need the confirmation (audited).

tools.name: cms_list_payment_providers
tools.description: Registered payment provider types with secret requirements.

tools.name: cms_list_payment_provider_instances
tools.description: Configured provider instances (secret refs are names, never values).

tools.name: cms_get_payment_provider_capabilities
tools.description: Capability report: cancel/refund/provider idempotency/status sync.

tools.name: cms_create_payment
tools.description: Create a payment; idempotency_key is the retry identity (payments.create).

tools.name: cms_list_payments
tools.description: Payment list with bounded filters.

tools.name: cms_get_payment
tools.description: One payment with normalized/provider status and amounts.

tools.name: cms_cancel_payment
tools.description: Cancel a CREATED/PENDING payment (payments.cancel).

tools.name: cms_refund_payment
tools.description: Privileged refund, partial or full (payments.refund; audited).

tools.name: cms_list_payment_events
tools.description: Append-only payment timeline (payments.events.read).

tools.name: cms_list_media_providers
tools.description: List installed, enabled media acquisition providers (stock/generation) with configured state. No credential material.

tools.name: cms_search_stock_media
tools.description: Provider-neutral stock image search. Returns candidates with opaque candidate_ref handles (import these; never construct URLs).

tools.name: cms_import_stock_candidate
tools.description: Import a stock candidate (from cms_search_stock_media) into the Media Library as a canonical asset. Duplicate-safe per provider asset.

tools.name: cms_generate_media
tools.description: Generate ONE image (cost-bearing; requires media.generate). Agent contract: read cms_get_media_provider_capabilities for models/sizes first, call cms_estimate_media_generation for the price, then generate with aspect+resolution from the model's size options (never raw pixels). count is clamped to 1 for agents. Poll cms_get_media_generation until ready — every candidate already carries media_id in the library; accept is optional replay.

tools.name: cms_get_media_generation
tools.description: Inspect a generation run: status, actual cost, and candidates — each with media_id (auto-imported into the library), preview_url, model, seed. Never reference preview URLs; use media_id.

tools.name: cms_get_media_provider_capabilities
tools.description: Models configured on a generation provider with their contracts: size options (aspect+pixels), resolution tiers, limits, negative/seed support, reference-image caps and published prices. Read this BEFORE generating.

tools.name: cms_estimate_media_generation
tools.description: Approximate generation cost for model+aspect+resolution+count BEFORE paying. Token-priced or unpublished-price models return an explicit refusal instead of a number.

tools.name: cms_validate_redirect_import
tools.description: Dry-run a legacy-URL redirect batch before importing (site migrations, SEO). Per-row report (invalid path, reserved, collision with a live route, duplicates, self-redirects, open-redirect targets) plus redirect-graph issues (loops, chains) checked against EXISTING history. Writes nothing. Workflow: validate first, show the owner the report, only then apply. Rows: source (old path), target (new site path or stable entry id; omit for 410 gone), status_code (301 default; 410 = permanently gone), reason.

tools.name: cms_apply_redirect_import
tools.description: Validate and apply a legacy-URL redirect batch atomically (any row or redirect-graph error aborts the whole batch). Sources must not shadow live routes; absolute/javascript targets are refused; loops and >3-hop chains across the batch AND existing history are refused. Requests go to old URLs from sitemaps, external links and search indexes afterwards resolve 301/410.

tools.name: cms_import_media_url
tools.description: Server-side pull of one remote image/file into the media library (site migrations, content imports). SSRF-safe fetch with per-hop checks, sha256 dedupe — an already-imported file returns the existing media_id with duplicate_blob true, so repeated references to the same source image cost nothing — and variants generated on accept. Returns media_id; reference it in content instead of the source URL.

tools.name: cms_accept_generated_media
tools.description: Optional replay path: candidates are already auto-imported into the library. Accepting again returns the existing asset (duplicate: true).

tools.name: cms_list_site_domains
tools.description: Domain bindings of a site (?site= key, default site). Requires domains.manage.

tools.name: cms_add_site_domain
tools.description: Add a domain binding (hostname normalized/validated; first binding becomes primary; single-primary invariant). Requires domains.manage.

tools.name: cms_set_primary_domain
tools.description: Atomic canonical-primary switch for a domain binding; sitemap/canonical pick it up immediately (no restart). Requires domains.manage.

tools.name: cms_remove_site_domain
tools.description: Remove a domain binding (the last one is undeletable; removing the primary promotes the first remaining). Requires domains.manage.

tools.name: cms_reidentify_entry_locale
tools.description: Identity repair: move an entry and its working revisions to a policy-allowed identity locale in one transaction. Entry id, routes, publication pointers, payloads and edit generations untouched; sealed history immutable. Refuses locales outside the site policy and translation-group members. Requires content.edit.

tools.name: cms_list_registry_releases
tools.description: Engine releases the registry serves (latest first), with sha256 and notes. Requires extensions.manage.

tools.name: cms_registry_apply_update
tools.description: Apply a registry release through the standard orchestrator (version must be strictly newer than the running one; backup → install → migrate → restart → doctor). Requires extensions.manage. If the connection drops mid-apply the server-side run continues.
